spans.s: चोदक (1) an objector; the word is co- mmon in the Commentary Litera- ture where likely objections to a particular statement are raised, without specific reference to any individual objector, and replies are given, simply with a view to mak- ing matters clear; (2) repetition of a word with इति interposed: cf. चेदकः परिग्रहः इत्यनर्थान्तरम्. See अदृष्टवर्ण and परिग्रह.
